segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a corrective hindsight recommendation rather than an additional manifested hidden occurrence.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 4 of 5 positive segments were detected with no false alarms (hit rate 0.8000; segment F1 0.8889). Including candidates reaches all five positive segments, but cand_002 is only a candidate near miss at the instance level.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: 3/5 hidden instances matched strictly at high_and_moderate (precision 0.7500, recall 0.6000, F1 0.6667); the anchoring case received the wrong label and overconfidence was missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: 4/5 hidden instances matched at high_and_moderate (precision 1.0000, recall 0.8000, F1 0.8889), recovering the anchoring mechanism despite the label mismatch.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates improve segment recall by surfacing the overconfidence episode, but they add no instance-level true positives and reduce precision because both candidates remain below the full-mechanism standard.
main_failure_modes: Availability heuristic was assigned to the anchoring instance, creating a strict label error despite full mechanism and localization overlap.
The overconfidence instance was not identified; its candidate was too tentative and underspecified to qualify.
Candidate-level output added a duplicate confirmation-bias claim and an overconfidence near miss.
main_strengths: Exact, well-supported matches for availability heuristic at decision point 2, bandwagon effect at decision point 3, and recency effect at decision point 4.
All evaluated findings used valid participant-attributed interview evidence and localized to eligible positive segments.
No false alarms occurred on negative eligible segments at any threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run is strong at segment-level detection and mechanism recognition but weaker at strict ontology-level labeling and confidence calibration. The recommended aggregate comparison should use high_and_moderate, where candidates are excluded and the mechanism-first taxonomy gap is visible.
